rules.name: recon-dup-03-view-explain
rules.sql: SELECT p.view_type, count(*) AS published_dates, min(p.settlement_date) AS first_date, max(p.settlement_date) AS last_date FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.business_unit = :bu GROUP BY p.view_type ORDER BY p.view_type
rules.explain: SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = :bu AND v.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING')

expect.reason: one BU and one date should read in well under 30 seconds
the snapshot, pointer and price tables must be read through their indexes
the planner estimates must be close, otherwise it picks nested loops
